problem.card3_desc: Revenge trading after losses, averaging down falling knives, and violating trade rules at 3 AM.

transformation.title: How your mindset shifts over 9 phases of practice
transformation.item1_before: Buys tokens because everyone says it will go up.
transformation.item1_after: Opens the order book, analyzes depth, spread, and queue volume before entering.
transformation.item2_before: Takes 50x leverage and gets liquidated on a 2% normal wick.
transformation.item2_after: Calculates position sizing via Kelly Criterion accounting for volatility and max risk.
transformation.item3_before: Stays awake all night checking charts every 5 minutes.
transformation.item3_after: Deploys trading bots with strict kill-switch logic and sleeps peacefully.
transformation.item4_before: Loses capital to phishing, unverified approvals, and scam tokens.
transformation.item4_after: Audits smart contracts, allowance limits, and maintains cold storage security.
transformation.item5_before: Blames market makers and treats trading like a casino.
transformation.item5_after: Understands fee structures, funding rates, MEV, and probabilistic execution.

psychology.title: The biggest vulnerability in any trading system is the person behind the screen

psychology.p2_desc: Prevents risk inflation and discipline breakdown following a series of profitable trades.
psychology.p3_desc: Overcomes reluctance to take small calculated losses and prevents revenge averaging.
psychology.p4_desc: Pre-commits trade rationale and worst-case scenarios before entering positions.
psychology.p5_desc: Evaluates decision quality and process execution rather than short-term luck.

kryptik.title: Kryptik — Your Demanding AI Mentor
kryptik.subtitle: A pragmatic senior peer who has mastered all 134 lessons:
kryptik.quote: “Logical. Incorrect, but logical. You confused liquidation with a margin call again. Review lesson 9.”
kryptik.f1: Diagnoses exact error types: conceptual, mathematical, or emotional traps.
kryptik.f2: Monitors live order flow: “4-pip spread. Stay calm, avoid hasty entries.”
kryptik.f3: Asks Socratic questions instead of handing out lazy answers.
kryptik.f4: Delivers no fake praise and no hype, building rigorous trading discipline.
kryptik.dialog_prompt: Kryptik: “Your bot entered a position, market dipped 3% triggering your risk threshold. What is your call?”
kryptik.reply1: “Classic loss aversion trap. You violated the bot charter and doubled your risk. Logged to your error journal.”
kryptik.reply2: “Correct. Process execution overrides any single outcome. Judges score technique, not lucky goals.”

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I need coding or prior trading experience?
faq.a1: No. The course starts at absolute zero, using interactive visual models and practical step-by-step simulations without complex code.
faq.q2: Does the simulator provide trading signals or investment advice?
faq.a2: No. The platform teaches mathematical principles, risk control, and psychological execution. We do not provide trading signals or financial advice.
faq.q3: What is included in the free tier?
faq.a3: All 20 lessons of Phase 0 and the full psychology module (P1–P8). You get permanent access without entering credit card details.
faq.q4: Will future updates require additional payments?
faq.a4: No. A single one-time payment of $12 (990 ₽) unlocks lifetime access to current and future course expansions with zero subscriptions.
faq.q5: What payment methods are supported globally?
faq.a5: We accept major international credit/debit cards, regional payment methods, and MIR cards via secure payment gateways.
faq.a6: Your progress is saved locally in your browser and automatically syncs across devices when you create a secure account.
